title: Choose a paid width for unknown finite-time local unitary encodings
statement: For unknown bounded nearest-neighbor H(t) with supplied B>=JT, the received corollary uses reversed negative time ordering to import the required generator orientation, obtains tau_D=4D exp(6eJT-D), and chooses a rational pre-outcome width paying the global tail floor and full4^w cost.

requires: Known physical line and supplied width; unknown logical supports/generators
Actual ordinary preparation/readout, contrast kappa, reset and common algebra
Separate global identity-dominance condition for the unrestricted joint comparator
A supplied weighted tail bound or the exact bounded nearest-neighbor unitary family with supplied B>=JT
provides: A finite conditional physical-family specialization without reconstructing H or the initial site placement
assumptions: Polynomial resources depend on fixed supplied B, not just small actual JT
Unknown local dissipative or memory processes remain outside
costs: Tail floor, width selection, all4^w dimensions, memory/control/routing and global Bell validation
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/Bell loss/half-diamond error as explicitly stated; source calls, resets, memory and control gates are separate costs.
contract.obstruction: Locality at an unknown time/strength does not supply an uncharged reliable width.

body: A supplied rational B>=JT is essential for the resource bound; a small unknown actual time with a loose B is insufficient. Unknown initial site placement is allowed, but geometry, Pauli/gauge structure, contrast, identity dominance and reset remain. Width grows with global accuracy and all4^w work must be paid; no inherited linear-size result. This does not cover arbitrary dissipative/local noise or non-reset dynamics. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed main, controls and statistics receipts at each final source. Supplied-bound and tail refinements preserve predecessor sources; no new locality-paper review or physical simulation is performed here.
